title: Assistant Manager – Financial Analyst
description:
Assistant Manager - Financial Analyst

About Inizio

Inizio is a global partner with over 10,500 experts operating in more than 50 countries. We support health and life science companies by turning science into strategy and executing across the product and patient journey.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager - Financial Analyst to support financial accounting, management reporting and FP&A activities. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, sound accounting knowledge, and the ability to prepare accurate MIS and financial insights for business stakeholders. Exposure to taxation will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and support accounting and financial reporting activities, ensuring accuracy and timely closure.

• Prepare and analyse monthly MIS reports , financial statements and management reports.

• Support FP&A activities , including budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.

• Analyse actual performance against budgets and forecasts and highlight key trends and variances.

• Prepare financial dashboards, management presentations and ad-hoc business analysis.

• Support month-end and year-end closing activities, reconciliations and financial controls.

• Partner with business and finance stakeholders to provide relevant financial insights for decision-making.

• Support internal and external audit requirements and ensure appropriate documentation.

• Assist in improving reporting processes, controls and overall finance efficiency.

• Support tax-related activities and compliance, where required.

Experience & Skills

• 5-7 years of relevant experience across accounting, MIS reporting and FP&A.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial statements .

• Hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting .

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel ; experience with ERP/accounting systems and reporting tools preferred.

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.

• Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage timelines independently.

• Knowledge or experience in direct/indirect taxation would be preferred.

Location: Gurugram

Qualification

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce or a related discipline .

• CA Inter/CMA Inter/MBA Finance or other relevant professional qualification would be an advantage.

Our Pledge

At Inizio, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity, and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

title: Accounts Receivable Manager
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Accounts Receivable Manager is a finance operations leader who will own Harvey's collections process and drive cash flow performance across a rapidly scaling global customer base. This role sits within the Finance team, whose mission is to build the operational backbone that supports Harvey's accelerating revenue growth and international expansion. By establishing a repeatable, scalable collections framework and closely monitoring DSO, this person ensures that Harvey maintains healthy cash conversion as deal volume and contract complexity increase. They will partner directly with Revenue Accounting, Deal Operations, Customer Success, and Legal to align the end-to-end order-to-cash cycle. It is a rare opportunity to build a critical financial function from the ground up at one of the most ambitious AI companies in the market.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own and manage the end-to-end accounts receivable and collections process - including invoice follow-up, dispute resolution, cash application, and customer communication.

- Establish and continuously refine a repeatable, scalable collections framework that keeps pace with Harvey's growth trajectory.

- Monitor, analyze, and report on DSO, aging, and other AR performance metrics, driving continuous improvement in cash collection timelines.

- Partner cross-functionally with Revenue Accounting, Deal Operations, Legal, and Customer Success to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure accurate, timely invoicing.

- Develop AR policies, procedures, and internal controls to support audit readiness and compliance with local and international accounting standards.

- Manage and optimize billing systems and tools (e.g., NetSuite) to improve accuracy and efficiency across the order-to-cash cycle.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 5+ years of progressive experience in accounts receivable, billing, or order-to-cash management, ideally in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.

- Strong working knowledge of collections best practices, credit management, and cash application processes.

- Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving AR/collections processes and establishing scalable controls in a fast-paced organization.

- Proficiency with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred), billing platforms, and Dunnings applications (Tesorio strongly preferred).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Finance, Sales, Legal, and Operations teams.

- Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.

title: Product Designer
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast is building a unified, enterprise-grade inventory platform that will power inventory for every Toast location, Restaurants and Retail alike. We are seeking a highly skilled, AI-native Product Designer to shape that experience: someone with a strong portfolio, a focus on exceptional UI design, and the hands-on ability to build working prototypes with AI tools like Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude. This role involves designing for the unique needs of a diverse customer base, including restaurants, hybrid models, convenience stores, bottle shops, grocery stores, and beyond.

You will be the product designer for inventory platform capabilities built by our Chennai teams, working day to day with a Chennai-based product manager counterpart and reporting to Toast Retail's design leadership in the U.S. Together you will turn product strategy into experiences customers can trust with their stock, their costs, and their books.

Why This Role Matters

Inventory is where a store's money sits. When stock counts are wrong, invoices are keyed in by hand, or costs don't reach the accounting system, owners lose margin and hours they don't have. The workflows you design will decide how supplier data, invoices, stock, costs, and revenue move through Toast and into our customers' accounting platforms, and whether the people doing that work, often at the end of a long shift, feel in control or buried in it.

You will be Toast Retail's design presence in our Chennai office: the on-site design partner for its product and engineering teams, and part of Toast's wider design community, including product designers in Bangalore. Because this work spans regions and time zones, the role calls for strong autonomous design judgment: keeping local teams unblocked, making well-informed design and scope tradeoffs within the broader product vision, and bringing US-based design, product, and business stakeholders in when direction, customer impact, or strategic choices need broader alignment.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

• Own design for your product area: Take your work from early discovery through shipped UI, connecting each workflow to the broader inventory platform vision.

• Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools such as Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude to build working, interactive prototypes with realistic data, so ideas can be tested with customers and engineers before the team commits to them. Use AI across the rest of your practice too, from synthesizing research to exploring concepts, validating outputs carefully and modeling responsible, secure use of AI for the team.

• Design AI-first workflows: Identify where AI can materially reduce customer effort, such as reading invoices, normalizing supplier and item data, and recommending catalog and accounting mappings. Design just as carefully for when it is unsure: how customers review low-confidence results, correct mistakes, and come to trust the system.

• Engage directly with customers: Research with retail and restaurant operators, and with the internal teams who support them, to understand their inventory needs, and translate those insights into design direction and testable ideas.

• Make complex data feel simple: Turn supplier catalogs, mappings, sync status, and errors into experiences that are clear, forgiving, and fast, on desktop and in the hand.

• Collaborate early and often: Partner closely with product managers and engineers in Chennai and the U.S., sharing work early, communicating design rationale clearly, and helping the team make good decisions quickly.

• Raise the craft bar: Deliver pixel-perfect UI, apply and extend the Toast design system with good judgment, and contribute to the quality of the wider Retail design practice.

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager, Electronic Components
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo's Supply Chain and Manufacturing teams are making the technology of the future a reality. We handle all production processes and supplier development strategies: from contracts and purchasing, to designs for improved manufacturing, through quality control and delivery. We collaborate actively with Waymo engineering teams as well as external suppliers and partners to make sure everything is built to spec and delivered on time to meet the rising demands of our business.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to the Head of Silicon & Compute Strategic Sourcing.

You will:

• Develop Category & Technology Strategy: Architect and execute multi-year sourcing strategies across key EE commodities (processors, custom ASICs/SoCs, PMICs, analog & mixed-signal ICs, passives, photonics/sensors, connectors, and high-density interconnect PCBs) aligned with Waymo's technical roadmap.

• Lead Commercial Negotiations : Drive all aspects of supplier negotiation, including market intelligence,  pricing, supply agreements, and contracts (SOWs/MSAs/HSAs/MPAs), to ensure best-in-class cost, quality, and supply assurance.

• Manage Supplier Performance: Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, leading regular business reviews to align on strategy, manage performance, lead various audits, and drive continuous improvement.

description:
MANAGER, COMMERCIAL SALES - EAST

Location: US East (remote), strong interest for New York City

THE ROLE

Our commercial segment is one of the more technically demanding sales environments in the industry. Our buyers are data engineers, platform architects, and technical founders - and the AEs who succeed here do so because they can meet those buyers as peers, not vendors. Building and leading that team requires someone who has done it themselves and knows what great looks like.

As Manager of Commercial Sales at ClickHouse, you'll own the performance, development, and culture of our Commercial AE team. You'll be expected to live in the details - reviewing pipelines, sitting on calls, pressure-testing deal strategy, and knowing every meaningful opportunity in the book. The best managers in this role won't be directing from a distance; they'll be the person their reps turn to when a deal gets complicated. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage from a dashboard. It's a role for someone who wants to build something.

You'll inherit a team that has real momentum, as our Commercial segment represents a significant % of our overall business.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Commercial Account Executives selling into the sub-250 employee segment - helping them close faster, think more technically, and operate with greater autonomy over time.

- Own the Commercial segment number. You're accountable for team attainment, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy - and you'll be expected to have a clear point of view on both at any given moment.

- Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing to ensure the Commercial team has the support, enablement, and feedback loops they need to win.

- Identify patterns across the pipeline - where deals stall, where we lose, and where we consistently win - and use those insights to improve team performance and inform product and GTM decisions.

- Contribute to the broader Commercial strategy, including segmentation, coverage model, and how we evolve the motion as the team scales.

WHAT YOU BRING

- A track record of success as a quota-carrying AE in a technical sales environment - you've sold data infrastructure, developer tooling, or a similarly technical product to engineering buyers and you know what that motion actually requires.

- Experience leading or mentoring other sellers, whether in a formal management role or as a senior IC who took ownership of team development. You know how to coach, not just direct.

- Technical credibility. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to earn respect in rooms full of them. You understand the modern data stack, can hold a conversation about architecture, and know enough to identify when a deal is stalling for technical reasons vs. commercial ones.

- Strong commercial instincts. You can read a pipeline, spot sandbagging, identify risk early, and have an honest forecast conversation with leadership without needing a week to prepare.

- A builder mentality. The playbook is still being written. You're comfortable operating in that environment and energized by the opportunity to shape it rather than frustrated by the ambiguity.

title: People Programs Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

People Programs at Ramp builds the programs that shape how employees experience the company day to day; from someone's first week to the moments that define Ramp's culture company-wide. As Ramp scales, we need someone dedicated to building that function and taking our foundations to the next level.

In this role, you'll own programs like onboarding, manager enablement, engagement surveys, and the company-wide culture and recognition programs that shape how Ramp works, to name a few. You'll work closely with People Business Partners, People Operations, and Comms to make these programs land and thrive.

This work is high impact and high visibility. This is a hands-on, build-from-scratch role for someone with strong judgment who owns things fully.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build your own roadmap by pulling signal from engagement survey results, PBP and manager input, and People Ops, then make the call on what to build, improve, delegate, or stop.

- Own onboarding effectiveness - from pre-start through the first week - so every new hire's first experience of Ramp reflects how we work and our culture, partnering with People Ops and IT on day-to-day logistics

- Own the performance review cycle's program design - timeline, tools, and the manager/employee experience - partnering with PBPs on calibration and outcomes

- Build and own manager enablement as a standalone program: design the content, frameworks, and moments that help managers lead well, in partnership with PBPs on delivery

- Conceive, build, and run company-wide culture-building programs, fully owning logistics and content end-to-end

- Own recognition programming: how we surface and celebrate what's worth celebrating across the company and the rituals/milestones that make Ramp's culture tangible day to day

- Own the biannual engagement survey: design, run, and work with People Business Partners to translate results into action

- Be the trusted voice on what we should build in-house versus buy (tools, vendors, platforms) for people programs, grounded in judgment about what's worth the investment, not a default toward either

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years owning people/culture programs end-to-end at a high-growth company - from ideation through hands-on execution

- A builder's track record: you've created programming that didn't exist before, not adapted someone else's playbook

- Strong facilitation and executive presence. You’re comfortable being the face of a program in front of the whole company, not just behind the scenes

- Comfortable with data: you can read engagement survey results and program metrics and turn them into a point of view, not just a report

- Proven ability to partner across functions (PBPs, Comms, Enablement, leadership)

- First-principles thinker who can turn ambiguity into a scalable framework: you don't need a rule book, but you can build one when it's missing

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematical Statistics, Actuary Science. Masters or Doctorate will be an added advantage.

The Associate Director, Commerce Search will lead retail media search strategy and activation for a beauty-focused client portfolio, with an emphasis on navigating the unique commerce ecosystems of specialty retailers and department stores.

We’re looking for a commerce marketer who understands that retail media goes beyond Amazon and Walmart. The ideal candidate brings experience working with beauty, luxury, fashion, or similarly retail-driven brands and understands how brands engage consumers across retailers such as Ulta Beauty, Sephora, Macy’s, Nordstrom, Bloomingdale’s, and other specialty and department-store environments.

In this role, you’ll translate retailer, consumer, product, inventory, and performance insights into smart search and commerce activation strategies. You’ll lead campaign strategy and execution, develop keyword and optimization approaches, manage retail media investments, and partner directly with clients, retailers, and internal teams to drive measurable business results.

You’ll also manage and develop a team while helping clients navigate an increasingly complex retail media landscape. Strong retail media experience is essential; beauty or adjacent specialty retail experience is highly preferred.

What You’ll Do

• Lead search and retail media strategy and activation across multiple retailer environments.

• Own keyword strategy, campaign setup, bidding, budgeting, optimization, testing, and performance reporting.

• Bring a strong understanding of specialty and department-store commerce, particularly how brands drive growth across retailer partners.

• Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, retailer media partners, and internal teams.

• Identify opportunities to connect retail search with the broader commerce and media ecosystem.

• Use performance data to identify trends and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Lead cross-channel testing and optimization strategies.

• Manage and develop direct reports, helping strengthen both their activation expertise and strategic capabilities.

• Stay ahead of developments across retail media platforms, ad products, technology, and measurement.

• Oversee campaign operations, including trafficking, billing/reconciliation, and data integrity.

Experience

• 5+ years of retail media, commerce search, paid ecommerce, or biddable performance media experience, with substantial hands-on retail search experience.

• Strongly preferred: experience supporting beauty, cosmetics, luxury, fashion, or another category heavily connected to specialty and department-store retail.

• Experience working with specialty retailers and/or department stores. Beauty retailer experience is especially relevant.

• Hands-on experience managing retail media/search campaigns and optimizing toward business and performance objectives.

• Experience across retail media and commerce platforms such as Amazon Ads, Criteo, Walmart Connect, Pacvue, and Skai, or comparable platforms.

We are looking for the founding members of this new business area for Netflix .

The Identity & Signals team builds the identity foundation of the Netflix ads business - the graph and matching systems that let us recognize the same person or household across signals, devices, and partner data sources, and that determine which signals we can responsibly and accurately use for targeting, measurement, and reporting. We build and maintain the identity graph, run and evaluate entity-matching and resolution pipelines, and manage relationships with identity providers so that advertisers and internal teams can trust the signals underneath every campaign.

This is a foundational role on a small, high-leverage team. You will build the analytics and data infrastructure that powers identity matching and graph construction - designing the tables, pipelines, and metrics that let the team and its stakeholders understand match quality, coverage, and drift over time. You'll work end-to-end: from raw signal ingestion, through matching logic and graph construction, to the dashboards and data products that make identity health visible and actionable across the company.

In This Role, You Will

• Design, build, and maintain the data models and pipelines that support identity graph construction, entity matching, and identity resolution across first-party and third-party signals.

• Partner with data engineering and software engineering to productionize matching logic, ensuring pipelines are scalable, well-tested, and monitored for data quality and drift.

• Build metrics, dashboards, and analytics that quantify match rate, match quality, coverage, and graph stability, and that surface anomalies before they affect downstream campaigns.

• Work closely with data science to evaluate and improve matching algorithms, providing the clean, well-documented data and features needed to test and iterate on models.

• Manage and evaluate the analytics relationship with external identity providers (e.g., Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp), including onboarding new sources, validating match performance, and monitoring ongoing data quality.

• Translate identity graph and matching concepts - nodes, edges, match confidence, deterministic vs. probabilistic matching - into clear, actionable insights for product, sales, and other non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborate with product and cross-functional partners to define identity requirements, evaluate trade-offs (accuracy vs. coverage vs. privacy), and prioritize roadmap work.

• Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the company.

We Are Looking For

• 5+ years of experience as an analytics engineer, data engineer, or similar role working with large-scale data.

• Experience working with graph data structures and graph-based data models (e.g., property graphs, graph databases, or graph analytics on top of relational/columnar stores).

• Familiarity with entity matching / identity resolution concepts - deterministic and probabilistic matching, fuzzy matching, blocking/candidate generation, and match quality evaluation.

• Knowledge of, or direct experience working with, identity providers such as Experian, TransUnion, LiveRamp, or similar data/identity partners.

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining prod

title: Staff Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

 

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. You will govern our hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, standardize backend data patterns across DynamoDB, relational, and analytical data stores, and ensure our core ad scoring pipelines remain resilient under massive load.

 

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

 

- Production Golang Systems & Architecture Mastery: You bring extensive backend development experience (7+ years, with deep production Go expertise in distributed environments). You will define service boundaries, concurrency models, and runtime optimizations for our +99% Go microservice architecture, scaling the platform reliably beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

- High-Throughput Event Streaming & Architecture Patterns: You have deep experience architecting and standardizing asynchronous microservice communication using event backbones like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will establish org-wide streaming standards, schema evolution, and CDC patterns to process billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

- Large-Scale Data Architecture & Platform Optimization: You understand database internals, distributed storage trade-offs, and low-level web standards. You will standardize data patterns (sharding, replication, DR) across hundreds of terabytes in DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena, while leading high-stakes, zero-downtime database migrations and deprecations.

- Data Science & Algorithmic Integration at Scale: You quickly grasp complex technical topics, distributed systems trade-offs, and applied mathematics. You will partner with our Data Science team to architect the runtime infrastructure that serves predictive models and machine learning algorithms directly within our sub-millisecond real-time ad targeting engine.

- Technical Leadership & Organizational Leverage: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You drive alignment across squads through RFCs and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), define org-level SLIs/SLOs, sponsor major technical migrations, and mentor Senior engineers across an international engineering team.

- Plus: Cloud Resilience & Tooling: Hands-on experience with continuous profiling (e.g., Pyroscope, goroutine dumps), chaos engineering drills, and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Kubernetes, or AWS cloud networking.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.

• Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.

• Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

• Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable service

description:
About the team

Hardware Procurement Operations enables OpenAI’s hardware and infrastructure businesses to execute supplier engagements and purchases at speed while maintaining financial discipline, clear ownership, and effective controls.

Our work spans procurement execution, process and systems enablement, and lifecycle governance-from initial requests and agreements through purchasing, payment, and closeout, with related asset and inventory governance. We build practical operating models, resolve cross-functional barriers, and improve the tools and processes that help teams scale.

About the role

You will own procurement execution for complex infrastructure deals, including land transactions, lease agreements, power purchase agreements, and fast-moving colocation and fiber engagements. Scope may expand to cloud service provider (CSP) engagements and sourcing activities as business needs evolve.

This senior individual contributor role combines hands-on lifecycle management with commercial judgment and building scalable operations. You will recognize gaps in proposed supplier engagements, work with business owners, sourcing, Legal, and Finance to improve them, and translate agreements into executable purchasing and payment plans. You will also build standard processes and automation that help teams move faster while reducing deal risk.

In this role, you will:

- Drive assigned engagements from intake and agreement execution through purchasing, ongoing obligations, amendments, renewals, final payments, and closeout.

- Assess commercial and operational readiness, identify gaps in scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and payment terms, and drive resolution with the appropriate partners.

- Resolve commercial, financial, and operational dependencies, aligning owners on required reviews and approvals. Represent procurement operations in deal planning and senior stakeholder escalations, presenting clear recommendations on commercial readiness, risks, and execution tradeoffs while respecting each function’s decision authority.

- Maintain accurate obligation and purchasing records; coordinate payment readiness, acceptance evidence, invoice exceptions, and reconciliation with business owners, Treasury, Accounting, and Accounts Payable.

- Establish procurement operating standards and influence business, sourcing, Legal, and Finance partners to adopt practices that improve supplier engagement quality, accelerate execution, and reduce risk. Build the processes, templates, playbooks, and upstream review cycles that make those standards actionable.

- Design, implement, and manage workflow automation and AI agents, partnering with technical teams where needed; own testing, adoption, monitoring, exception handling, and appropriate human review and approval controls.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have independently managed complex procurement engagements through post-signature execution and closeout, with experience in at least one infrastructure category such as land, leases, power, colocation, or fiber.

- Can distinguish well-structured supplier engagements from those that create avoidable ambiguity or exposure, recommend practical improvements, and recognize when Legal or Accounting judgment is required.

- Understand contractual obligations, payment structures, and procurement controls, and can translate them into clear execution plans.

- Can independently prioritize time-sensitive engagements, navigate ambiguity, and resolve cross-functional dependencies, seeking guidance on complex or consequential decisions. Communicate risks and tradeoffs clearly and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

- Have built repeatable processes in an ambiguous environment and use procurement, contract management, and ERP systems and operational data to improve execution.

- Have delivered workflow automation or AI agent solutions with measurable results and can manage their reliability, exceptions, and controls.

We’re hiring a Talent Coordinator to run the hiring engine that brings great people onto the Sharp team. This role reports to the Senior Recruiter.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Recruitment Business Partner to lead recruitment delivery for a portfolio of client accounts from our India delivery centre. You will lead a team of team leads and recruiters, partner with Sales and client hiring managers, and own the full hiring cycle from requirement to joining.

This is a delivery leadership role, not a desk-recruiting role. You will be measured on outcomes: how quickly strong candidates reach the client, how many are selected, and how many join. You will also act as a trusted advisor to Sales and clients, using market insight and data to shape realistic requirements, rates and timelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Delivery ownership

- Own monthly and quarterly hiring targets (selections and joiners) for the accounts in scope.

- Prioritise open requirements each week, and decide which to push, escalate or pause.

- Make sure quality profiles reach the client quickly, especially on priority roles.

- Track every requirement from intake to joining, and step in early when a role stalls, a candidate disengages or an offer is at risk.

Stakeholder management

- Lead intake and calibration discussions so every role has a clear brief, a realistic budget and an agreed interview process before sourcing starts.

- Agree feedback timelines with Sales and clients, and follow up with data when they slip.

- Advise Sales on which requirements are likely to close and where the team should focus.

People leadership

- Lead, coach and manage team leads and recruiters against clear weekly productivity goals.

- Run regular performance reviews, identify gaps early and put development plans in place.

- Hire, onboard and ramp up new recruiters, and develop future team leads.

Process and data

- Make sure the team follows the agreed recruitment process, with accurate and complete data in the applicant tracking system.

- Use dashboards and reports to find bottlenecks across the hiring funnel (submission → interview → selection → joining) and fix them.

- Keep offer and post-selection drop-outs low, and lead root-cause reviews when they rise.

Quality and candidate experience

- Raise screening quality so clients see fewer, better-matched profiles.

- Make sure every candidate receives timely updates and a clear outcome.

Sourcing channels

- Work closely with the central sourcing team on role allocation, handovers and turnaround time.

- Make effective use of job boards, referrals, vendor partners and internal talent pools.

Reporting

- Prepare monthly account and team performance reviews for leadership, with clear commentary on trends and actions.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

- Selections and joiners against target

- Time to first qualified profiles on priority roles

- Submission-to-interview and interview-to-selection conversion

- Offer and post-selection drop-out rates

- Joiner retention in the first 30 days

- Team productivity and data quality

- Stakeholder satisfaction (Sales and client feedback)

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

- 8-12 years in recruitment, with at least 3 years leading recruiters or team leads against delivery targets.

- A strong background in IT recruitment or staffing (contract, permanent or managed services), ideally for international clients.

- A proven record of meeting hiring targets, which you can back with your own numbers.

- Confidence with senior stakeholders: you run intake calls, challenge with evidence and handle escalations calmly.

- Strong analytical skills: comfortable with funnel metrics, Excel and BI dashboards.

- A coaching leadership style that balances accountability with development.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

- Experience with Global Capability Centres (GCC), offshore or captive delivery models.

- Experience working with European clients and across time zones.

- Experience integrating teams after a merger or acquisition.

- Experience managing recruitment vendors.

- Hands-on experience with ATS and CRM tools.

You'll own the full hiring rhythm: planning, sourcing strategy, pipeline health, calibration, weekly progress tracking, issue-spotting, and continuous improvement.

It's a great fit for someone who has already managed a tech recruitment function and team, and wants to grow within an environment that moves and scales fast, and holds a genuinely high quality bar.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the Engineering hiring engine end to end: understand and collaborate on workforce plans, clarify hiring priorities, translate them into hiring strategies, and make sure the team is set up to deliver against business needs.

- Directly manage a team of TA Partners: full ownership of their performance, development, clear direction and priorities, coaching on search strategy and stakeholder management, and unblocking execution where needed.

- Drive hiring outcomes across technical domains and hubs: take accountability for progress, quality, and delivery across Engineering hiring in our main hubs Barcelona, London and Kyiv, while personally owning a couple of complex and high-impact searches.

- Build and optimize hiring processes: identify what slows us down, where quality drops, or where ownership is unclear - then improve the process so we can hire top talent in the most effective way.

- Track progress through data: run a strong weekly hiring rhythm, using funnel data, pipeline quality, pass-through rates, time in stage, sourcing performance, and stakeholder feedback to understand what's working and what needs to change.

By combining proprietary satellite technology, advanced AI forecasting models, and actionable analytics, Tomorrow.io delivers hyper-local weather insights that protect lives, strengthen operations, and build climate resilience globally.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the role:

Cohere is at the forefront of AI innovation, building cutting-edge language models and AI systems. Our Finance team plays a critical role in supporting our rapid growth and ensuring operational excellence. We value technical expertise, collaborative problem-solving, and a commitment to accuracy and compliance. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our financial infrastructure while working at the intersection of finance and transformative technology. As we scale our business and navigate an evolving financial landscape, you'll play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and serving as a key partner on accounting implications of major business decisions.

In this role, you will:

- Lead the complete month-end close process, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting across all entities

- Own lease accounting, including accounting assessment under ASC 842, recording and reconciliation of lease-related account transactions, financial reporting, and disclosures

- Own equity accounting such as stock-based compensation under ASC 718 and IFRS, as well as all other equity-related balance sheet accounts

- Oversee foreign currency accounting, including functional currency assessment, transaction exposure, and translation adjustments

- Assist with recording purchase accounting, including purchase price adjustments, acquisition-related expenses, fair value allocations, and related reconciliations

- Direct general ledger operations, account reconciliations, and financial statement preparation

- Implement and maintain robust accounting policies, procedures, systems, and internal controls

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure financial accuracy and support business growth

- Leverage technology solutions to enhance accounting efficiency and accuracy

You may be a good fit if you:

- Have 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with prior leadership in fast-paced environments

- Possess strong technical accounting skills and deep understanding of GAAP principles, including lease accounting, equity accounting, business combination, and foreign currency

- Have direct experience owning month-end close processes using close management tools such as Numeric

- Demonstrate expertise in purchase accounting, including acquisitions, purchase price adjustments, and related reconciliations

- Experience with leveraging AI tools to build and improve workflows to achieve operational efficiency and accuracy

- Demonstrate excellence in problem-solving and process improvement methodologies

- Show proficiency with financial systems (Netsuite preferred, but not required)

- Exhibit strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across departments

- Thrive in high-growth, dynamic environments with evolving priorities

- Have experience building scalable accounting processes in technology companies

title: Senior Key Accounts Manager (Central/West)
description:
Description:
The Senior Key Accounts Manager - Regional Payers is a senior individual contributor responsible for the business-to-business relationships, strategic account planning, and measurable business performance of an assigned regional payer portfolio. The Senior Key Accounts Manager will be accountable for gaining, protecting, and improving profitable formulary and medical policy access; influencing downstream adoption and accurate implementation of parent-account access; identifying and advancing financially sound regional contracting opportunities; quantifying business impact; leading approved pull-through; and bringing actionable payer intelligence into portfolio and launch decisions. This role requires cross-functional leadership with Pricing and Contracting, Finance, Legal, Medical Affairs and MSLs, Brand, Patient Services, Field Reimbursement, Sales, Trade, Analytics, Government Affairs, and other internal stakeholders.
Essential Functions:
Opportunity Advancement and Business Outcomes:

• Secure, maintain, and improve profitable formulary placement and written medical policy coverage across pharmacy and medical benefits.

• Identify and advance financially sound regional contracting and strategic partnership opportunities in alignment with the applicable Key Account Manager and approved parent-account strategy.

• Build and present business cases using volume, claims, reimbursement, formulary, competitive, rebate, discount, and financial data; clearly articulate forecast impact, access risk, expected return, and recommended action to senior leadership.

• Support or lead approved regional contract discussions and manage opportunities through approval, signature, implementation, and performance monitoring.

• Measures of success: advance at least one priority opportunity each quarter and deliver two to three documented access or business wins annually.

• Current portfolio measures include advancing at least two systemic access issues across the Specialty portfolio; targeting two measurable coverage or implementation improvements through priority BCBS and other regional plans and selected large IDN specialty centers or health-system accounts; and qualifying three Biosciences or Pipeline opportunities, including Medicaid coverage opportunities, with at least one advanced annually.

Account Focus and Coverage Intelligence:

• Serve as the primary account owner and day-to-day Amneal contact for assigned East or West regional health plans and downstream payer accounts.

• Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with Amneal portfolio objectives and the applicable parent-account strategy.

• Build multi-level relationships across pharmacy, medical, contracting, industry relations, utilization management, and other relevant customer functions.

• Maintain current knowledge of each account's decision-making structure, lines of business, PBM and rebate aggregator relationships, benefit design, utilization management, coverage criteria, and implementation processes.

• Maintain a cross-portfolio coverage, barrier, and opportunity tracker for priority Blues, regional plans, IDNs, health systems, and Medicaid plans.

• Measures of success: Every priority account has current coverage status, a defined business issue or opportunity, an accountable owner, a next step, and timing.

Strategic Engagement and Pull-Through:

• Lead approved regional payer, Blue, IDN, health-system, or state engagement when tied to a defined access issue, contracting opportunity, implementation need, or broader business priority.

• Develop, implement, and measure PRC-approved pull-through strategies based on formulary and medical policy access.

• Work with Sales, Field Reimbursement, Patient Services, Brand, Medical Affairs, Trade, and other matrix partners to resolve barriers and maximize the value of access wins.

• Communicate account-specific coverage changes, affordability issues, and local business impact through approved training,

title: Event Coordinator & Executive Assistant
description:
About HowGood & Regen House

HowGood is a sustainability intelligence company helping the food industry measure and reduce its environmental and social impact.

Regen House, powered by HowGood , is a global home for strategic action on regenerative food systems. At Climate Week NYC, London Climate Action Week, UN Climate COPs, the World Economic Forum, and more, we convene senior leaders from food, finance, and government with farmers and Indigenous communities in sessions built to drive measurable outcomes.

The role

This role is largely focused on supporting the execution of our Regen House events, but will also have the opportunity to work with our CEO and other leadership to support their admin. This is a chance to see up close how a fast-growing climate company builds partnerships, and to play a real part in it.

It's a great fit for someone who loves details, moves easily between priorities, and is passionate about climate and food systems.

Event Coordinator Responsibilities:

• Event planning and admin: Support venue, vendor, run-of-show and logistics planning, and keep timelines and trackers up to date.

• Partnership comms: Help manage outreach and ongoing communication with partners and sponsors.

• Contract funnel and comms: Track contracts from draft to signature and invoicing, and keep partners informed at each step.

• Own smaller events: Plan and run select smaller events as assigned, from concept through day-of execution and wrap-up.

• Systems development and efficiency: Build and refine the trackers, templates and workflows that keep Regen House running smoothly, and find ways to make each event cycle smoother than the last.

Executive Assistant Responsibilities:

• Calendar management: Own and protect executive calendars, balancing priorities and flagging conflicts early.

• Meeting scheduling: Coordinate internal and external meetings across time zones

• Travel booking: Book and manage travel and accommodations, and prepare clear itineraries.

• Conference prep and follow-up: Coordinate outreach before conferences, schedule meetings and plan executives' time onsite. Track follow-ups afterward.

• LinkedIn posting: Draft, schedule and publish LinkedIn posts for select executives in their voice.

We think you'll thrive in this role if you:

• Have 1-3 years of experience in event coordination, project management, or a closely related administrative or assistant role.

• Build your own systems to organize and manage complex, multi-part projects for consistent follow through

• Can juggle competing priorities and stay calm when plans change

• Write clearly, succinctly, and warmly, building strong relationships with partners, executives, and other stakeholders

• Bring a strong sense of ownership and care, for the details and for the bigger mission

• Are comfortable with Google Workspace, Slack, project trackers like Notion, and LinkedIn

• Bonus: Use AI tools in your workflows beyond basic drafting, such as organizing information, streamlining repetitive tasks, or setting up automations. You're curious about new tools and eager to keep learning.

Application Process:

We aim to respond to every applicant within two to three weeks, whatever the decision. Here's what to expect:

• Submit Application

• Screening Interview

• 2-3 interview rounds with members of our leadership team you'd be working with

• Reference and background check

• Offer

title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Analyst
description:
Careers with real impact.
Every role at Orsini moves a patient closer to life-changing therapy. We partner with biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to make access simple, compassionate, and reliable - so no patient is left behind. Make your next role matter.

ABOUT ORSINI
Providing compassionate care since 1987, Orsini is a leader in rare disease and gene therapy pharmacy solutions, built to simplify how patients connect to advanced medicines. Through our comprehensive commercialization solutions including a nationwide specialty pharmacy, patient services hub, home infusion and nursing network, and third-party logistics provider, we work with biopharma, providers, and payors to ensure No Patient is Left Behind™
OUR MISSION
Orsini is on a mission to be the essential partner for biopharma innovators, healthcare providers, and payers to support patients and their families in accessing revolutionary treatments for rare diseases. Through our integrated portfolio of services, we seek to pioneer comprehensive solutions that simplify how patients connect to advanced therapies while providing holistic, compassionate care so that No Patient is Left Behind™.
CORE VALUES
At the heart of our company culture, the Orsini LIVE IT Core Values serve as guiding principles that shape how we interact with each other and those we serve. These values are the driving force behind our commitment to excellence, collaboration, and genuine care in every aspect of our work.
COMPENSATION & LOCATION
The salary for this role is $55,000.
This is a remote position with occasional travel for team or customer meetings. Candidates located near our Elk Grove, Illinois or Columbus, Ohio offices are preferred.
POSITION SUMMARY The Specialty Pharmacy Program Analyst position works in collaboration with the Program Manager to provide support for assigned manufacturer program(s) and therapies. The analyst will be a key contact interacting with the manufacturer, HUB and case management teams, prescribers, prescriber office staff and patients.

The role will require a high sense of urgency and the ability to answer questions quickly or respond/resolve issues that may arise. This support includes providing concise and accurate patient status information, participate and facilitate manufacturer status update meetings, ensure manufacturer contract obligations met, and provide prompt follow-up on inquiries from assigned manufacturer(s). Works as part of account team to build strong manufacturer relationships. The analyst will support internal therapy team by assisting in processing orders and/or handling escalated cases as time allows around manufacturer activities. The analyst will be actively engaged in manufacturer program manager and therapy team to ensure program requirements are met and program is operating as designed.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES

• Provide concise and accurate patient status information from system and/or via collaboration with other team members to assigned manufacturers.

• Collaborates with internal SPP teams or team members to expedite patient processing as needed.

• Identify, investigate, and resolve escalated issues and cases related to complex reimbursement.

• Serves as point of contact to manufacturer field reps, MD offices, and/or patients for all assigned orders.

• In conjunction with Program Manager, leads weekly (or more or less frequently as needed) calls with manufacturer.

• Perform manufacturer-specific enhanced services such as specialized welcome calls or contractual timed patient calls directed by Program Manager/Therapy Team Manager

• In collaboration with program manager, identify patients with potential for a delay in initial or refill shipment and create strategy to expedite or escalates situation to management as necessary.

• Attend scheduled manufacturer, program manager and therapy team meetings.

• Prepare and/or review internal reports for assigned therapy and manufacturer as requested.
